main.note: 玉螺湖村 (傅家坡): from 天驼关's valley the wide 黄土大道 runs south (a spur west toward 黑松山) to the 三叉路口, where the road goes on south to 京师's 北驿道 and the 青石小路 turns west into the village: the farmhouse and its back yard north of it, 刘家 (the garden, the old wooden house, its kitchen), the great melon field south of it behind its ditch, the melon guards' shed. The path ends in tall grass by the lake; pushed aside, the grass shows a way west to the valley outside 忘情谷 on the lake's far shore. South of the garden it goes down between willows past the lakeside (fishing boats on the shore), the rice field and 田老财's three-room house behind its black gate. 玉螺湖 fills the south-west; its middle is a map of its own (the boat), its ice cave too.

midlake.note: 玉螺湖's middle: a fishing boat on the misty water, mountains far to the west, the fishermen on the east shore waving. Only the boat reaches it (paddle from the lakeside); a dive from it breaks the ice of the lake's floor into the ice cave.

props: the boat's rounded stern and bow

icecave.note: 水下岩洞 below 玉螺湖: where the dive breaks through, a cave of ice white as the north's 玄冰, glowing algae, the way in frozen over at once; west it opens into a vast hall under a half-clear dome where six white dragons hang in the air, coil on the ice or swim in its pool; an ice stair winds up west to the valley outside 忘情谷.
